scope: Finite RFC 5322 section 4 syntax-family inventory and proposed fictional production-boundary vectors; not an exhaustive grammar or cross-product certificate.

primarySource.title: RFC 5322 section 4, Obsolete Syntax
primarySource.receiverObligation: Accept and reasonably interpret obsolete forms; do not generate them in newly constructed headers.
primarySource.normativeDistinction: MUST receiver acceptance differs from SHOULD route removal, zone interpretation and repeated-destination combination; field ambiguity can remain unspecified.

execution.sourceAssertions: Inspected exact checked-in test bodies. Presence is not a new passing execution claim.

fixtureBase.provenance: New fictional examples derived from RFC productions, not copied private mail or imported upstream corpus. Escapes in patch strings are JSON escapes representing intended octets; the build script never executes a fixture.
fixtureBase.lineEnding: CRLF unless the specific vector deliberately changes it
fixtureBase.rawTemplate:
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 12:01:00 +0000
From: Sender <sender@example.test>
To: Reader <reader@example.test>
Subject: Fictional obsolete syntax
Message-ID: <obs-{id}@example.test>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=us-ascii

Fictional body {id}.
fixtureBase.patchRules: Replace the matching header name case-insensitively, preserving intentional repeats and byte escapes; prepend/replace-body/replace-all are explicit. Date matrices replace Date only. Do not normalize away the syntax under test before production entry.

core-to-reader-v1.providerBoundary: Use an isolated fictional TLS endpoint and MailService.hydrate_message_with_imap_endpoint_for_test for the actual selected header/body publication path. Respond only with requested HEADER.FIELDS; do not invent selective support for omitted optional fields.
core-to-reader-v1.storage: Persist actual summaries and CachedMessageContent, drop connections, reopen Store, compare all exposed fields and neighbors. No hand-authored replacement payload may stand in for core output.
core-to-reader-v1.reader: Extend the real core-profile -> message_content Tauri command -> Reader artifact lane; assert visible subject/sender/body, real reply targets and no unsolicited action. This is source/event acceptance; native WebKit remains separate.
core-to-reader-v1.rawSource: When asserting retention of uninterpreted bytes, use MailService.fetch_raw_message_at_epoch_with_endpoint_for_test and exact fictional source bytes. Do not claim unknown raw headers are stored in a cache that has no such fields.
core-to-reader-v1.emission: Inspect newly constructed reply/compose header bytes; obsolete route/trace must not be manufactured. Verbatim source export or an attached original message is not newly constructed header generation.
core-to-reader-v1.negativeAndIdentity: Retain adversarial encoded-looking addr-spec and Message-ID tokens literally. Do not broaden parser decoding to make a fixture pass; ensure account/mailbox/UIDVALIDITY stay immutable.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret obsolete controls and quoted-pairs robustly.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No indexed controls-in-header/quoted-pair acceptance, cache or Reader oracle. Controls are receive content, never permission to send command framing bytes.

proposedVectors.expected: Keep sender mailbox sender@example.test; no fabricated header or action; decide and document visible control normalization while retaining retrievable original bytes.
Accept bounded historical input without native/HTML execution; preserve printable alpha/omega order. Exact display normalization needs an explicit oracle, not an inferred standard rendering rule.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Handle historical body and unstructured line endings.

existingEvidence.limit: One CR-only MIME fixture; not arbitrary mixed CR/LF/NUL acceptance.
No obsolete controls or Reader/cache acceptance.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: CR-only normalization is partial evidence; mixed separators, NUL and control-as-content remain unproven. Reasonable interpretation does not require unsafe terminal control execution.

proposedVectors.expected: Bounded body processing, printable tokens retained in order; exact chosen line-ending normalization documented; raw fetch/export must retain original octets.
Resolve the historical bare-CR ambiguity explicitly; no silent body-as-header promotion or injected recipient. This case requires a policy oracle before claiming exact display semantics.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret dotted phrases and empty phrase-list members.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No exact dotted-display/empty Keywords family assertion indexed. Dotted or quoted modern display samples alone do not prove this production.

proposedVectors.expected: Sender address stays exact and display tokens do not become addr-spec segments.
Mail body remains readable and original header remains retrievable. No invented Keywords UI is required.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Accept consecutive folds, including whitespace-only continuation lines.

existingEvidence.limit: Ordinary folded recipients and group; not whitespace-only continuation or null members.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Existing normal folding lacks two consecutive folds and whitespace-only-line preservation through complete/header/catalogue/cache/Reader.

proposedVectors.expected: Header does not end at the whitespace-only continuation; subject contains alpha then omega without exposing continuation as body.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret obsolete year widths and token comments.

existingEvidence.limit: Modern four-digit numeric-zone Date, not obsolete year/zone interpretation.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Modern valid-date and missing/invalid-date fallback tests cannot prove these obsolete values. Vendor date corpus is adjacent only, not a core/Reader acceptance lane.

proposedVectors.expected: Each Date yields its listed year at midnight UTC in all metadata/complete paths; a supplied conflicting IMAP INTERNALDATE must not hide incorrect Date interpretation.
Interpret the intended 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z rather than silently using receipt time.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret obsolete zones and unknown-zone recommendations.

existingEvidence.limit: Modern four-digit numeric-zone Date, not obsolete year/zone interpretation.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No indexed core test covers US-zone alternatives, military-zone recommendation or unknown-zone policy. Do not turn provider fallback into a pass for valid obsolete dates.

proposedVectors.expected: Assert listed UTC instants; A uses unknown-local-offset semantics, not the historic +0100 assumption. Preserve the distinction if any local-zone label is displayed.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret routed addresses without using obsolete routing.

existingEvidence.assertion: the user-visible time comes from Date, not an obsolete Received route
existingEvidence.limit: Route appears in Received, not a direct From/To route or cache/Reader acceptance.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Existing Received route acceptance does not prove direct originator/destination routes, null route-list entries or Reply All targets.

proposedVectors.expected: The terminal sender/reader mailboxes remain exact; route domains are not recipients, identities or destinations. Reply preparation must not reintroduce route syntax.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret comments and quoted words within obsolete addresses.

existingEvidence.assertion: the receive-only obsolete local part must be detected before tolerant parsing
existingEvidence.limit: One encoded-looking local-part with CFWS; not all obsolete local/domain grammar.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: One CFWS-before-@ guard is partial. General quoted-word/dot/comment combinations remain untested. The separate modern quoted-local-part gap is not obsolete-only.

proposedVectors.expected: Interpret sender.part@example.test without changing meaningful local-part bytes; no encoded-word decoding inside identity.
Preserve the literal quoted local-part identity and produce a valid reply target; never collapse it into another mailbox. Exact serialization oracle must account for meaningful quoted whitespace.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret null members in address and group lists.

existingEvidence.limit: Ordinary folded recipients and group; not whitespace-only continuation or null members.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Existing valid group/folded recipients do not include leading, adjacent and trailing null members or comma-only group lists.

proposedVectors.expected: Keep exactly the two real To mailboxes and an empty group; no phantom recipient or parse failure. Reader Reply All retains the real recipients only.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret historical domain-literal escapes and controls.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No indexed core domain-literal obsolete escape/control oracle. SMTP envelope policy is separate from safe received-message interpretation.

proposedVectors.expected: Keep the domain-literal address distinct and literal; do not reinterpret it as an application URL, local-file path or command.
Bounded receive interpretation without retargeting; define safe reply behavior for the control-bearing domain rather than silently inventing a routable address.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Accept historical field order, repetition and pre-colon whitespace.

existingEvidence.limit: First Date/From/Subject policy only; does not prove repeated destination concatenation.
Duplicate Message-ID/References policy; not destination fields or full pipeline.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Existing duplicate singleton policy is exact but does not prove whitespace before colon, all field families or alternate ordering. Non-destination duplicate interpretation is not specified by this RFC.

proposedVectors.patch:
Subject 	: reordered
To : reader@example.test
From	: sender@example.test
Date : 28 Jul 2026 12:01:00 +0000
proposedVectors.expected: Same exposed metadata/body across full/header/catalogue and reopen despite order and whitespace. Singleton ambiguity uses the documented deterministic policy.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Accept pre-colon whitespace in origination dates.

existingEvidence.limit: Modern four-digit numeric-zone Date, not obsolete year/zone interpretation.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: The combined whitespace/year/zone receive case is absent at core and Reader boundaries.

proposedVectors.expected: Use the valid historical message date, even with a conflicting provider INTERNALDATE; no invented now().

existingEvidence.limit: First Date/From/Subject policy only; does not prove repeated destination concatenation.

existingEvidence.assertion: the receive-only obsolete local part must be detected before tolerant parsing
existingEvidence.limit: One encoded-looking local-part with CFWS; not all obsolete local/domain grammar.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No complete originator family oracle for spaced field names/Sender delegation/Reply-To; first-singleton and encoded-looking identity regressions are narrower.

proposedVectors.patch:
From 	: sender@example.test
Sender : delegate@example.test
Reply-To	: replies@example.test
proposedVectors.expected: Expose original sender and explicit Reply-To correctly. Sender/delegate must not replace From or silently retarget reply. Raw unknown fields remain retrievable.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Interpret repeated destination fields as combined address lists.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: High-value untested recommendation: current first-singleton evidence does not cover To/Cc/Bcc combination. This audit did not run the vector and does not assert that production fails.

proposedVectors.patch:
To: first@example.test
To : second@example.test
Cc: copy-one@example.test
Cc	: copy-two@example.test
Bcc : , ,
proposedVectors.expected: Preserve both To and both Cc mailboxes in order for Reader/Reply All; empty Bcc members add nobody. If deviating from the concatenation recommendation, document and test the deviation explicitly.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Ignore surrounding phrases and identity CFWS when interpreting IDs.

existingEvidence.limit: Encoded-looking identifiers stay literal; no phrase/CFWS obsolete identifier oracle.
Duplicate Message-ID/References policy; not destination fields or full pipeline.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Modern canonical ID lists and literal encoded-looking IDs do not prove these obsolete phrase/CFWS forms or cache/thread/Reader convergence.

proposedVectors.patch:
In-Reply-To : old discussion <parent@example.test>
References	: intro <root@example.test> trailing <parent@example.test>
proposedVectors.expected: Only the two real identifiers contribute to threading; words are ignored, with account isolation and no cycles.
Compare the semantic ID left.part@example.test without treating comments as identity bytes. Preserve original source, and never apply encoded-word decoding while normalizing CFWS.

existingEvidence.limit: First Date/From/Subject policy only; does not prove repeated destination concatenation.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No exact pre-colon informational/empty phrase-list family acceptance; adding a Comments/Keywords UI is not required by this map.

proposedVectors.patch:
Subject 	: visible subject
Comments : fictional comment
Keywords	: alpha,,beta,
proposedVectors.expected: Reader displays the correct Subject/body; optional informational headers neither override identity nor trigger actions. Original fields remain available via raw fetch.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Treat obsolete resent information as trace.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No indexed core resent-family boundary assertion. Lack of a resend feature removes generation work, not receive acceptance.

proposedVectors.patch:
Resent-Date : 28 Jul 26 12:02:00 GMT
Resent-From : forwarder@example.test
Resent-To : reader@example.test
Resent-Reply-To : rerouter@example.test
Resent-Message-ID : <resent@example.test>
proposedVectors.expected: A prepended resent block does not replace original From, Reply-To, Date or conversation identity; preserve original header source. No sending occurs merely because these fields exist.

existingEvidence.assertion: the user-visible time comes from Date, not an obsolete Received route
existingEvidence.limit: Route appears in Received, not a direct From/To route or cache/Reader acceptance.

receiverFamilies.remainingGap: Folded Received/route already has a narrow source assertion; Return-Path and pre-colon forms/cache/Reader remain unproven. Formal server trace validation belongs to RFC 5321, not this client syntax map.

proposedVectors.patch:
Return-Path 	: <sender@example.test>
Received : from relay.example by mailbox.example; 28 Jul 26 12:01:00 GMT
proposedVectors.expected: Trace headers do not override Date/From or become reply destinations; body remains readable and raw trace bytes retrievable.

receiverFamilies.receiverRule: Accept whitespace before an optional field colon.
receiverFamilies.remainingGap: No indexed optional spaced-header boundary assertion. Displaying or interpreting arbitrary optional fields is not required.

proposedVectors.expected: Unknown header does not reject the message, alter known identity or create a privileged action. Raw fetch/export retains the uninterpreted bytes.

adjacentAddressProfileGap.expected: The literal local-part must not become attacker through encoded-word decoding. Pin mailbox identity at complete/header/catalogue/threading/reply boundaries; quote removal for serialization must not change meaningful local-part octets.
adjacentAddressProfileGap.limit: Existing angle/bare/quoted-display guards do not establish this quoted-local-part combination. No product change or pass is asserted.

roles.classification: transmit-only prohibition, not a missing receiver feature
roles.action: Keep modern compose/SMTP serialization regressions. Do not test by emitting obsolete syntax to a live provider.

roles.role: Honoring obsolete source routes for delivery
roles.action: Test ignoring route domains during receive/reply interpretation; do not implement relay routing.

roles.classification: not applicable to currently absent resend feature
roles.action: Receive acceptance and trace-only non-retargeting still apply.

roles.role: Interpreting arbitrary optional headers, Comments or Keywords in UI
roles.classification: no advertised structured UI, not permission to reject the message
roles.action: Test acceptance, unaffected displayed fields and exact raw retrieval; do not invent UI requirements.

roles.role: Server trace validity, routing history and SMTP envelope operations
roles.classification: outside this RFC 5322 client syntax map
roles.action: Keep trace acceptance separate from RFC 5321 sender/server requirements.

adjacentVendorEvidence.limit: Vendored resource/unit coverage does not prove Date selection, INTERNALDATE precedence, SQLite state or Reader output. No vendor test was executed by this audit.

existingReusableLanes.role: Reusable parse/reopen semantic pattern; the proposed obsolete families are not currently its corpus.
Existing nine-fixture real profile exporter; requires deliberate fixture/contract expansion.
Coordinates real core profile, real Tauri message_content command and Reader assertions; existing success is not obsolete-family evidence.

limitations: A finite family inventory is not an exhaustive parser grammar or all token combinations.
All proposed vector results are untested. Existing neighboring source assertions must not be promoted to passes for these vectors.
Display normalization for historical control characters and mixed bare CR/LF requires an explicit policy oracle before exact presentation assertions.
No tests, source policies, unsupported declarations, matrix counts, native apps or provider mailboxes were changed by this audit.
